title: Hi, I'm Isaac.
bio: Full-stack developer in Costa Rica. I design systems, automate processes and build AI agents.
bioRoles: Developer at Visione Edge and owner of The Growth Path.

story.title: It started with solving problems
paragraphs: I started coding at 17, in Python and without AI. From the start, what hooked me was finding problems and solving real needs.
I got better step by step. Today I lead projects at Visione Edge: I handle the technical side as a developer and I also negotiate with clients.
I like designing systems with technology, automating processes and analyzing where the market is heading, across industry and technology.
story.quote: Often it isn't about the product, it's about the need you're trying to solve. Understanding it deeply is what creates the most value.
